text:
The deploy went out but staging is unhealthy: `/healthz` was still returning 503 when the 60s healthcheck timed out.

Build, push, and rollout of `api:7f3c2e1` all succeeded, so the problem is at runtime. The new pods may be crash-looping, failing readiness, or still starting up if the service needs more than 60s. I haven't looked at pod status or logs yet, so I don't know which.

Staging is currently running the new image in this state. Should I dig into the pod status and logs, or roll staging back to the previous image first?
